notes.title: UPDATE: Caching histograms for Cribbage Solitaire
notes.content: Today's update changes the histograms for Cribbage Solitaire to be included with the game instead of being downloaded from our servers.

notes.title: UPDATE: Fix for blurry cards in Proletariat's Patience
notes.content: Today's update fixes an issue with blurry cards in Proletariat's Patience when using low-quality textures.

notes.title: UPDATE: Fixing a Mac-specific hang when starting the game
notes.content:
This update fixes a Mac-specific hang when starting the game.

It also adds some black bars when zoom is enabled on non-16:9 displays.

notes.title: UPDATE: Crash fix
notes.content: Today's update fixes a crash when starting the game with zoom mode enabled.

notes.title: UPDATE: Stack movement and screen zoom
notes.content:
Today's update adds two new features that can be turned on in the in-game options menu:

[list]
[*] An auto-mover for Fortune's Foundation that moves entire stacks of cards to follow the first.
[*] An experimental zoom feature that makes some of the smaller games fill up more of the screen.
[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE: Achievements and click-click dragging
notes.content: Today's update adds some achievements and a setting that, when turned on, makes it so that you can drag cards without having to hold the mouse button.

notes.title: UPDATE: Assorted bug fixes
notes.content:
Today's update includes the following changes:

[list]
[*] [Sigmar's Garden] Locked marbles are back to being faded, although a little less so than in Opus Magnum.
[*] [Sawayama Solitaire] Made the auto-mover more conservative, so that it never causes you to lose a game.
[*] [Kabufuda Solitaire] Fixed a bug where opening the instructions while dealing would cause cards to disappear.
[*] [General] Fixed the dealing sound effects for all of the games to be interruptible and non-stacking.
[*] [General] Fixed a crash when failing to find a valid window resolution.
[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE: Fix for blurry mouse cursors
notes.content: This update fixes a bug where the mouse cursors in Sawayama Solitaire and Cluj Solitaire were blurry when using low-resolution textures.
